notes: Batch 45 of polishing session. 7 of 10 entries modified. Basic tier entries expanded to 5 examples: koto, mieru, sou. Fixed formality tags on 2 entries (yorokobu, atsumeru) that had incorrect 'formal' tag - these are neutral verbs. Fixed politeness tag on mieru (only sense 3 'come-honorific' is honorific, the word itself is plain). Fixed cross-reference types for transitive/intransitive pairs (atsumaru/atsumeru). 5 general tier entries (yureru, hikaru, nusumu, tasu, yorokobu) were already compliant at 3 examples. Key finding: (1) Formality describes the word's inherent register - most common verbs are 'neutral' even if they appear in formal contexts, (2) Politeness 'honorific' should only be used if the word itself is an honorific form, not if it has an honorific sense, (3) Transitive/intransitive pairs should use type 'pair' with descriptive label, not 'see_also'.
